signals.text: Arsenal may move for Endrick in January - Sunday's gossip. Barcelona may launch a huge offer for Haaland, Arsenal are interested in struggling Endrick, and Liverpool insist on keeping Wirtz
Suzuki proves worthy replacement for Martinez at Villa. Aston Villa new boy Zion Suzuki deserves as much credit as anyone for their first Premier League win of the season at struggling Tottenham.

Goodwin double helps London City win at struggling Charlton. London City Lionesses earn their first away win of the season, with Isobel Goodwin scoring twice, as they emphatically beat a struggling Charlton side who have now lost all three of their WSL games.
